commit.message: remove all legacy kcor functions and calls

files.patch:
@@ -21685,6 +21685,8 @@ TASK081_ZPHOT_SDSS_MLCS+HOST_5PAR       :  mis-match (REF != TEST)
     snlc_sim.c[h]
      + add PERIOD to SIMGEN_DUMP list; writes -9 for non-recurring models
        and writes LCLIB's "PERIOD" value for recurring-periodic
+     + remove all legacy kcor functions and remove use of
+       INPUTS.USE_KCOR_[LEGACY,REFAC]
 
     Everywhere: add callFun arg to splitString so that abort message
                 can be traced back to calling function.

 #define SPECTROGRAPH_OPTMASK_noNOISE 32768  // internal only: turn off noise
 
 typedef struct {

   return(SNR);

+
+  // Created May 2023
+  // Create IDEAL spectrograph with 10 A bins and SNR per bin = 1E4.
+  // This enables writing true SEDMODEL without the headache of
+  // creating a spectrograph table.
+  // This feature is invoked with sim-input key
+  //   SPECTROGRAPH_OPTMASK:  128
+
+  char fnam[] = "void create_ideal_spectrograph" ;
+
+  return;
+} // end void create_ideal_spectrograph
